questions.stem: Which of the following best explains the meaning of the quote: '95% right per step is 36% right after 20 steps.'?
options: It shows that small errors can compound over time, leading to a significant loss of accuracy.
It indicates that accuracy improves with more steps, so 20 steps are better than 1.
It means that being correct 95% of the time guarantees being correct 36% of the time in the long run.
It suggests that making mistakes is less harmful when done over many steps.
questions.source_quote: 95% right per step is 36% right after 20 steps.

questions.stem: According to the statement 'An agent is a model using tools in a loop,' which of the following best describes the core concept of an agent's operation?
options: An agent relies solely on pre-programmed rules to make decisions without external input.
An agent operates in isolation and does not interact with external tools or environments.
An agent continuously cycles through perception, decision-making, and action using available tools.
An agent's primary function is to store and retrieve data without processing it.
questions.source_quote: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

questions.stem: According to the quote 'The harness is everything that is not the model,' which statement best defines what the harness represents?
options: The harness consists of all elements excluding the model.
The harness is the same as the model.
The harness is a subset of the model.
The harness includes all components of the model.
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the relationship between the tool loop and the feedback loop, based on the quote: 'The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it.'?
options: The tool loop and the feedback loop are both responsible for executing tasks.
The tool loop performs the action, while the feedback loop evaluates the outcome.
The tool loop and the feedback loop operate independently and have no direct relationship.
The feedback loop is responsible for initiating the process, and the tool loop ensures it is completed.
questions.source_quote: The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it.
